entities.summary: Ramaz Paliani is a Georgian former amateur and professional boxer who represented the Unified Team, Georgia, Russia, and Turkey during his career. He is a multiple European Champion, World Champion, Olympic bronze medalist (1992), and later worked as a boxing coach.
